notes.title: 1.3.1V
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce the release of Patch 1.3.1. This update includes the following improvements and fixes:

Cloud Save: Added support for cloud saving to ensure your progress is safely backed up.
Skill Tree Exploit: Addressed and fixed the exploit related to the skill tree.
Menu Navigation Issues: Resolved various issues with menu navigation and transitions.
Triple Gate Issue: Fixed the issue with the missing pause menu for the triple gate.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. If you encounter any further issues or have suggestions, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

Happy gaming!

Redex Entertainment

notes.title: 1.3V
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks for your feedback and kind wishes. Your opinions are incredibly valuable to us. In this patch (version 1.3), we have made the following updates:

Bug Fixes and Visual Enhancements: We have addressed various bugs and made visual improvements.
Icon Update: The game icons have been refreshed.
Mini Map Added: A mini map feature has been incorporated into the game.
Card Information: Card details are now available in the Pause Menu.
Cursor Errors: Issues with the cursor have been resolved.
Marketplace Bugs: Bugs in the marketplace section have been fixed.
Save Errors: Save-related errors have been corrected.
These changes address minor issues identified by both our team and your valuable feedback. If you encounter any further problems, please do not hesitate to leave a comment and contact us.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Happy gaming!

Redex Entertainment

notes.title: Patch 1.2V
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the negative experiences caused by some bugs that appeared in our game following the recent update. We are constantly working to provide you with a better gaming experience, and in this context, we have released a new patch to fix these issues.

Here are some of the major issues addressed in this patch:

Visual glitches
Some spells not firing
Inability to progress to the final level
We hope this update resolves the issues you have encountered and enhances your gaming experience. Your feedback is very valuable to us, and it allows us to continuously improve our game. If you have any questions or suggestions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Happy gaming!

Redex Entertainment
